hmm.name: Carb_anhydrase
hmm.threshold_source: Curated GA scores stored in the downloaded Pfam HMM; sequence and domain both 27 bits for PF00194.27.

similarity.alignment: Biopython PairwiseAligner global optimum; canonical SHA-256 orientation; first optimal alignment resolves ties.
similarity.identity_denominator: All alignment columns, including terminal and internal gap columns.
similarity.coverage_denominator: Residue-residue aligned columns divided by each full sequence length separately.
similarity.partitioning: Connected components of all qualifying pairs; no component crosses a split.
similarity.filtering: Lossless length-ratio and multiset bigram upper bounds; exact global alignment for remaining necessary pairs.
similarity.edge_count_note: Joining edges form a spanning forest. The full number of qualifying edges is not measured because redundant within-component pairs may be skipped.

limitations: Pfam GA and domain coverage establish sequence-family compatibility; they do not establish carbonic-anhydrase catalytic activity, expression, folding, or wet-lab function.
The cross-split audit excludes qualifying pairs under the stated global metric; it does not eliminate distant homology.
Fine-tuning split isolation does not establish absence from DPLM pretraining data.
Public API contents may change after the recorded UniProt release; accession-level sequence hashes in frozen-splits.json identify this snapshot.
Timings are measured examples and depend on hardware and cache state.
Size-first whole-component allocation produced singleton components in validation and test in this snapshot; interpret generalization with this split composition in mind.
